info.title: DHPanel API
info.description: Control plane API for the DHPanel hosting panel. Errors use RFC 9457 Problem Details (`application/problem+json`).

422.description: Invalid input; one error per field

delete.summary: Delete an administrator. Their sessions end; audit entries stay.

patch.summary: Change an administrator's email, status or two-factor requirement.

422.description: Nothing to change, or invalid input

post.summary:
Remove an administrator's second factor and backup codes (lost phone) and
end their sessions. If 2FA is mandatory for them, they must enrol again.

204.description: Second factor removed (also when there was none)

put.summary: Give an administrator a role (no change when they already have it).

delete.summary: Take a role away from an administrator (no change when they do not have it).

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Only actions starting with this text, e.g. `auth.` or `auth.login_failed`.

parameters.name: target_type
parameters.description: Only entries about this kind of object, e.g. `session`.

parameters.name: target_id
parameters.description: Only entries about this object (use with `target_type`).

get.summary: Everything the admin interface needs after sign-in.

200.description: The caller, their permissions, the modules being served, branding and the CSRF token. Never cached.

403.description: `not_an_administrator`: customer accounts use the customer bootstrap

delete.summary: Delete a feature set that no plan uses.

get.summary: List the features the installed modules offer (for the feature set editor).
List the modules of this installation.

put.summary: Switch a module on or off. Takes effect at once, without a restart.

200.description: Done (also when nothing had to change)

404.description: No such module in this build

409.description: `module_is_core`; `module_has_dependents` (switching off: the detail names the modules that need it); `module_needs_dependencies` (switching on: the detail names the modules it needs). Repeat with `cascade` to switch those too.

get.summary: List the enrolled nodes with their live status.

post.summary: Add a node: creates a one-time enrollment token.

409.description: `node_name_taken`: a node or a valid token already uses the name

get.summary: List recent enrollment tokens (never the tokens themselves).

delete.summary: Cancel a token that has not been used yet.

post.summary:
Ask a node to answer a ping (a liveness check that goes through the whole
pipeline). Each call is a new ping unless an `Idempotency-Key` header says
it is the same request.

Revoke a node: its certificates stop working and its connection is closed.
Final; the server has to be enrolled again with a new token.

Try a failed operation again as a new operation. Asking twice returns the
same new operation.

get.summary: List every permission key the installed modules declare, for the role editor.
List the numeric limits the installed modules declare (for the plan form).

422.description: Invalid fields, an unknown feature set, or `exceeds_node_capacity`

409.description: `plan_name_taken` or `plan_is_default` (the default plan cannot stop being the default; make another plan the default instead)

422.description: Invalid fields, an unknown feature set, or `exceeds_node_capacity`

delete.summary: Delete a plan that no account is on.

get.summary: List the settings of every module that has some.

200.description: Modules with settings, their schemas and current values

put.summary:
Change some settings of a module. All values are checked first; if one is
not acceptable nothing is changed. The change, with the old and new value
of every setting that differs, is written to the audit log.

422.description: Unknown setting, wrong scope, or a value that breaks the schema (one entry per problem, `values.<key>`)

post.summary: End every session of the signed-in account, including the current one.

200.description: Current account and the session's CSRF token

post.summary:
Confirm TOTP enrolment with a code from the authenticator app. Enables
2FA and returns the backup codes (shown only this once).
Disable TOTP and delete all backup codes. Requires sudo mode.

204.description: 2FA disabled (also when it was not enabled)

post.summary:
Start TOTP enrolment: returns a new secret to add to an authenticator app.
2FA is not active until the secret is confirmed with a code.

200.description: New secret; calling again before confirming replaces it

get.summary: List the signed-in account's live sessions.

post.summary: End every other session of the signed-in account ("log out everywhere else").

200.description: Other sessions ended; the current one stays

delete.summary:
End one of the signed-in account's sessions. Ending the current session
is a logout and clears the cookie.

404.description: No such live session for this account

post.summary:
Enter sudo mode: prove identity again so sensitive actions are allowed
for the next few minutes (`auth.sudo_minutes`).

403.description: `password_incorrect`, `mfa_code_required` (2FA is on and no code was sent), `invalid_mfa_code` or `csrf_failed`

post.summary: Log in with username or email and password.

202.description: Password accepted but a second factor is required: a short-lived `__Host-dh_mfa` cookie is set; continue with POST /api/v1/public/auth/login/mfa

403.description: Correct password but account suspended or disabled

429.description: Too many failed attempts for this account or address

post.summary: Second login step: verify a TOTP or backup code and start the session.

200.description: Logged in; session cookie set, pending cookie cleared

401.description: `invalid_mfa_code`, or `mfa_session_expired` when the pending login is missing or older than 5 minutes

post.summary: Exchange an enrollment token and a certificate request for a node certificate.

201.description: Enrolled; the token is used up

401.description: `invalid_enrollment_token`: unknown, used, cancelled or expired (deliberately indistinguishable)

409.description: `node_name_taken`: a node with that name appeared meanwhile; the token is still usable once the name is free

422.description: Invalid certificate request or fields; the token is not used up

429.description: Too many failed attempts from this address

503.description: `enrollment_unavailable`: this control plane has no node CA yet (run `dhctl ca init`)

get.summary: Readiness: all dependencies (database, redis, ...) are reachable

503.description: At least one check failed or timed out

next_after.description: Pass as `after` to get the next page; absent on the last page.

created_at.description: When the account was created (RFC 3339, UTC).

last_login_at.description: Last successful login (RFC 3339, UTC), if any.

mfa_enabled.description: A second factor is set up.

mfa_required.description: Two-factor authentication is mandatory for this account.

actor_ip.description: IP address the request came from.

correlation_id.description: Request correlation id; matches the `x-request-id` header and the logs.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next (older) page; absent on the last page.

backup_codes.description: Ten single-use codes; store them somewhere safe.

Bootstrap.description: What the admin interface needs to start.

csrf_token.description: Send as `X-CSRF-Token` on POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE. Keep it in memory only.

features.description:
Plan features. Administrators have no plan, so this is empty; the
customer bootstrap fills it.

limits.description: Plan limits and usage, by key. Empty for administrators.

locale.description: The language to use: the account's, else the panel's default.

modules.description: Modules being served right now, in dependency order.

permissions.description:
Permission grants: exact keys, subtrees (`admin.*`) or `*`. For showing
or hiding things; the server checks every request.

enabled.description: A second factor is set up.

setup_required.description:
Mandatory but not set up: the interface should send the user to the
security page; protected endpoints answer 403 `mfa_setup_required`.

BootstrapModule.description: A module that is being served.

name.description: Name; also the feature key of its interface module.

oneOf.description: Entry in the administrator's menu, if it has one.

order.description: Position in the group, lower first.

Branding.description: The panel's look, from the `system` settings.

default_language.description: Language used when the account has no preference (`en` or `bn`).

maintenance_notice.description: A notice for all users while it is not empty.

panel_name.description: Name shown on the sign-in page and in the browser tab.

code.description: Code currently shown by the authenticator app.

password.description: Initial password; must satisfy the password policy.

username.description: Login name: 3-32 characters, a-z, 0-9, `_` or `-`, starting with a letter.

name.description: Name for the new node: 2-63 characters, a-z, 0-9 and `-`, starting with a letter.

CreatedEnrollment.description: A newly created enrollment token. **The token is shown only in this response.**

enroll_command.description: Command to run on the new server. Absent when `agent.public_url` is not configured.

expires_at.description: When the token stops working (RFC 3339, UTC).

id.description: Token id (use it to cancel the token).

name.description: The node name this token is for.

token.description: The one-time token. It cannot be shown again.

EnrollRequest.description: What an agent sends to enrol (plain HTTPS, before it has a certificate).

csr_pem.description:
PEM certificate signing request made with a fresh ECDSA P-256 key that
never leaves the node.

token.description: The one-time token from the "add node" screen.

ca_certificate_pem.description:
The CA certificate (PEM) that signed it and that signs the control
plane's server certificate.

ca_fingerprint_sha256.description:
SHA-256 fingerprint of the CA certificate (lowercase hex), to compare
with the one in the enrol command.

certificate_pem.description: The node certificate (PEM): client authentication for the mTLS connection.

not_after.description: Certificate expiry (RFC 3339, UTC). The agent renews before this.

protocol_version.description: Protocol version the control plane speaks.

stream_url.description:
Where the agent opens its long-lived mutual-TLS connection
(`https://host:port`), when the control plane has the agent port switched on.

EnrollmentView.description: An enrollment token as listed (without the token itself).

created_by.description: Account that created it, if it still exists.

name.description: The node name it is for.

FeatureList.description: Every feature of the installed modules.

FeatureSetInput.description: What a feature set is made of (create and replace).

all_features.description: Every feature of every module. Then `features` must be empty.

name.description:
Unique name: 2-32 characters of `a-z`, `0-9` and `_`, starting with a
letter. Ignored when updating a built-in set.

all_features.description: Every feature of every module, including ones added later.

built_in.description: Created by the installation: cannot be renamed or deleted.

unknown_features.description:
Keys in the list that no installed module declares: kept, but they
enable nothing.

module_title.description: That module's display name by language code.

field.description: JSON pointer-ish field path, e.g. `email` or `limits.max_domains`.

message.description: Human-readable message (English; the UI translates by `code`).

LimitList.description: Every limit of the installed modules.

LimitView.description: A numeric limit a module declares.

default.description: The value a new plan gets.

module_title.description: That module's display name by language code.

Me.description: The signed-in account and its session's CSRF token.

csrf_token.description: Send as `X-CSRF-Token` on POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE. Keep in memory only.

mfa_required.description: An administrator made two-factor authentication mandatory for this account.

mfa_setup_required.description:
Two-factor authentication is mandatory but not set up yet: until it is,
permission-protected endpoints answer 403 `mfa_setup_required`. The UI
should send the user to the security page to enrol.

permissions.description:
Permission grants from all roles: exact keys (`admin.roles.read`),
subtrees (`admin.*`) or `*` for everything. Use them to show or hide
UI; the server enforces them on every request.

MfaChallenge.description: Body of the 202 answer to a password login when 2FA is enabled.

expires_in.description: Seconds until the pending login expires.

code.description: A 6-digit authenticator code or a backup code.

active.description: Modules whose routes are being served after the change.

changed.description:
Modules whose switch changed, including the one asked for (empty when
it already was in the requested state).

ModuleView.description: A module as shown to administrators.

active.description: Its routes are being served right now (switched on, with everything it needs).

dependents.description: Modules that need it, directly or indirectly: switching it off stops these too.

present.description:
Part of the running build. A module that is not is listed for history
and cannot be switched.

capabilities.description:
What the server reported about itself: `cpu_cores`, `memory_bytes`,
`disk_total_bytes`, `disk_free_bytes`, `kernel`, `docker_version`,
`docker_mode` (`rootless`/`rootful`), `cgroup_v2`, `seccomp`,
`apparmor`, `user_namespaces`, `agent_version`. Empty until the first
report, which is requested when the node connects and then hourly.

public_ip.description: Address the agent last connected from.

status.description:
`online`, `offline`, `draining` or `revoked`. `online` means the agent
answered a heartbeat within the last 45 seconds.

OperationView.description: An operation as shown to administrators.

error.description:
Why it failed (`code`, `message`, `retryable`), also the last failure of
an operation that is being retried.

idempotency_key.description: The key that makes asking again harmless.

output.description: What the node produced, on success.

PermissionView.description: A permission key that modules declare.

module_title.description: That module's display name by language code.

present.description:
Declared by the running build. A key that is not stays listed, because
roles may still hold it, but grants nothing that exists.

PlanInput.description: What a plan is made of (create and replace).

is_default.description: Make this the default plan for new accounts.

limits.description:
Module limits by key: `-1` (unlimited) or zero and more. Declared limits
left out get their default.

name.description:
Unique name: 2-32 characters of `a-z`, `0-9` and `_`, starting with a
letter. Ignored when updating a built-in plan.

built_in.description: Created by the installation: cannot be renamed or deleted.

is_default.description: New accounts get this plan unless told otherwise.

limits.description: Module limits by key; `-1` is unlimited.

unknown_limits.description: Limit keys that no installed module declares: kept, but they limit nothing.

PutSettings.description: New values for some settings of a module.

values.description:
Setting key to new value. Settings not mentioned keep their value;
writing a setting's default puts it back to the default.

checks.description: One entry per registered probe, sorted by name.

Resources.description: The resources of a plan's containers. `-1` means unlimited.

bandwidth_mb.description: Transfer per month in megabytes; 0 or more.

cpu_millis.description: CPU in thousandths of a core (1000 = one core); 10 to 256000.

disk_mb.description: Disk space in megabytes; 1 or more.

session_closed.description: Whether an open connection was closed.

SessionView.description: A live session of the signed-in account.

created_at.description: When the session was created (RFC 3339, UTC).

current.description: Whether this is the session making the request.

expires_at.description: When the session ends regardless of activity (RFC 3339, UTC).

last_seen_at.description: Last recorded activity (RFC 3339, UTC; up to a minute behind).

SetModule.description: A change of a module's switch.

cascade.description:
Also switch what has to change with it: when switching off, the modules
that need this one; when switching on, the modules this one needs.

changed.description: Keys whose value actually changed (empty if nothing did).

values.description: Current values of the module, by key.

SettingsView.description: A module's global settings: what they are and what they are now.

schema.description:
The settings as a JSON Schema: each property has `type`, `default`,
optional `enum`, limits, `title` / `x-title` and `description` /
`x-description`. Only the settings that apply to the whole panel.

title.description: Display name by language code (falls back to the English `title`).

values.description: Current values (the default where nothing was changed), by setting key.

StatusInput.description: Status an administrator can be set to.

code.description: Authenticator or backup code; required when 2FA is enabled.

sudo_expires_in.description: Seconds until sensitive actions need re-authentication again.

TotpEnrollment.description: A new, not yet confirmed TOTP secret.

otpauth_uri.description: `otpauth://` URI; render it as a QR code for the authenticator app.

UpdateAdministrator.description: Changes to an administrator; omitted fields stay as they are.

session.name: __Host-dh_session
session.description: HttpOnly session cookie set by POST /api/v1/public/auth/login

tags.name: auth
tags.description: Login, logout, the current account and two-factor authentication
